fee_notes: Fee varies by program: (1) Single Store Development Program: $50,000 Initial Franchise Fee (with a $15,000 Location Fee applicable as credit); (2) Multi-Store Development Program: $40,000 per Restaurant, with a non-refundable Development Fee of $20,000 per Restaurant (total $40,000–$300,000 for 2–15 restaurants) credited toward each franchise fee; (3) Purchase Program: $0–$300,000 depending on location, lease term, condition, operating history, profit margin and volume. Renewal/New Franchise Agreement fee is $50,000. Franchisor reserves right to reduce or waive fees; fees subject to variance under Development Incentive Program. All fees are non-refundable except to limited extent under Development Incentive Program.
raw_excerpt: The Initial Franchise Fee under the Purchase Program generally ranges between $0 to $300,000, depending on the particular facts and circumstances concerning the Restaurant, including its location, term of lease, the condition of the premises, its operating history, if any, profit margin and volume, and the condition of the personal property, as applicable. ... If you enter into a Franchise Agreement, you must construct and equip the Restaurant, acquire and convert an existing building or acquire an existing IHOP Restaurant, and pay an Initial Franchise Fee of $50,000. ... For each Restaurant you develop, you must sign a separate Franchise Agreement and pay an Initial Franchise Fee equal to $40,000.
